svg.title: An accumulation function and its slope
svg.desc: Top: the graph of f(t) = 0.5t + 1 for t from 0 to 6, with the area under it from 0 to x = 3 shaded; that area is g(3) = 5.25, and the height of f at t = 3 is 2.5. Bottom: the graph of the accumulation function g(x) = x squared over 4 + x, rising and concave up, with the point (3, 5.25) marked and a dashed tangent line there whose slope is g prime of 3 = f(3) = 2.5.
